Start a parallel cluster and run the calibration

start_cluster.Rd

Creates a cluster with control$nCores workers, exports the objects and libraries each worker needs, runs the AHR-ES optimisation with calibrate and stops the cluster. Same as run_calibration, except that the cluster is not stopped if the optimisation fails.

Usage

start_cluster(control)

Arguments

control

A named list of calibration control parameters passed to calibrate. Must contain at minimum nCores (integer, number of parallel workers).

Value

Called for its side effect of running the calibration. The result of calibrate is not returned.

Details

The function relies on objfn, forcing, observed, setup and likelihood_function being present in the calling environment.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
  start_cluster(control = list(nCores = 4, maxit = 5))
} # }
